string.text: Loot Claim
Loot Claim
Who may loot what
When a body is opened
Compatibility and messages
Debug
Enable Loot Claim
Off: the mod blocks nothing, everybody may loot everything (vanilla behaviour).
Player can loot everyone
NPCs do not claim bodies: the player may loot any body, including NPC kills.
NPCs can loot everyone
The player does not claim his kills: NPCs may loot bodies killed by the player and companions.
Companions = player
Companion kills count as player kills (NPCs cannot loot them). Off: such bodies are free for everybody.
Claim mutants
Mutants killed by NPCs are off-limits for the player while the claim is active.
Lootable if the killer is dead
A body killed by an NPC opens for the player once the killer has died.
Lootable if the killer is far away
If the killer is farther than the set distance (or not loaded), the body can be looted. Checked on every attempt: the body is never closed for good.
"Killer is far" distance, m
Killer-to-player distance beyond which the body can be looted (needs the option above).
Lootable after being looted
Once a body has been looted (by an NPC or the player) it opens for everybody.
Delay before NPCs may loot player kills, sec
How many seconds after the player opens his own kill NPCs may loot it.
Block Autolooter
Autolooter (z_auto_looter) obeys the claim too: its own key and proximity looting.
Show claim messages
Warning tip from the killer or a message when the player may not loot a body.
Debug (write to log)
Write the mod's decisions to xray_*.log, lines start with [grok_loot_claim].
